_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With 0 of 74 windows producing a ±2+ point move, the coil is the dominant reality and a high-conviction HOLD is the skilled call until a breaker emerges.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes — both call HOLD/sideways with medium conviction; the split is only in narrative tone (analyst cautious on valuation, narrative more constructive on structure).
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC funding drops below 0.001% with exchange netflow turning negative and retail_noise_velocity cooling below 70, signaling quiet accumulation breaking the coil toward Disbelief
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 20 with DXY breaking 100 and btc_exchange_reserves_pct_30d dropping below 50, forcing a risk-off flush toward Panic
